address: 5F, 8 Lyndhurst Terrace, Central, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Sol is Latin for sun, and a metaphor for the passion and energy of the kitchen team as they reimagine Korean classics using modern Western techniques. The set menu starts with amuse-bouches inspired by banchan – Korean home-style side dishes. Their signature Jeju abalone is seasoned with two kinds of Korean seaweed for a burst of seafood umami. Each course comes with a card that describes its cultural significance, elevating the experience....
